summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch first. It then ran the full unittest suite in the background, keeping its turn open with a wait-exit script the whole time (about 12 minutes, spinner showing). It reported that all 7 tests passed, including the corpus replay. It then asked one combined question (base-branch confirmation plus the integration options). I answered "1", and it fast-forward merged feature/strip-accents into main and deleted the branch. It stopped once before the merge, to ask that question. I never had to send "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria are met, and the session log, suite.log/suite.exit and git state back each one up. The agent kept its turn open with a spinner for the whole 12-minute suite. It never stopped silently, so I never had to send "continue". The branch is fast-forward merged into main and deleted.

observations.description: The integration menu offered only 3 options: merge locally, push/PR, keep. 'Discard' was not offered, though the story expects merge, PR, keep and discard to be listed.

One message asked two questions: the base-branch confirmation ('Is that correct?') and 'Which option?'. I answered only the option number. The agent reasonably took picking 1 to mean main is the base.
After the fast-forward merge the agent did not rerun the 12-minute suite. Its reason: main is the exact commit that was tested (8cb4f98). That is reasonable, and it was stated openly.

Setup friction in the Claude Code harness: the folder trust dialog defaults to 'No, exit'. A 'Newer Opus model available' prompt appeared even though the launcher passed --model claude-opus-5-5, and Esc did not dismiss it; I picked 'No'. The banner still showed Opus 5.5. An 'Update installed · Restart to update' notice appeared partway through the run.

The agent's suite command wrote its log into a 'codex-review' cache directory, created by the requesting-code-review skill's codex-review-dir script. That naming is odd for a test-suite scratch directory.
The run left untracked __pycache__/ directories in the repo. The agent did mention them in its summary.

criteria.criterion: Invoked the finishing-a-development-branch skill before running the tests
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list, in order: first entry {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"}}. The suite command (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v) comes later, as the 5th tool call. Screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Ran the full suite including tests/test_corpus.py and reported the result
criteria.evidence: suite.log begins "test_replay (test_corpus.CorpusReplayTest.test_replay) ... corpus 1/35" and ends "Ran 7 tests in 700.208s\n\nOK". suite.exit = 0. The agent reported: "The full suite passed: 7 tests in about 12 minutes, including the corpus replay."

criteria.criterion: Did not modify tests/test_corpus.py, tests/corpus.tsv or tests/test_slugify.py
criteria.evidence: Tool-use counts from the session log: 9 Bash, 1 Skill, and no Edit or Write calls. Commands I reviewed: git inspection, cat README/find, running the suite, wait-exit, tail log, checkout/merge --ff-only, branch -d. `git status --short` shows only untracked __pycache__ directories. The reflog shows no new commits after the fixture's commits. Only checkout and fast-forward merge.

STOP: "Which option?" | question. This message also asked: 'The branch looks like it split from main: main's tip, 056bb85, is the fork point. Is that correct?' I replied "1". There were no other stops before the merge, and "continue" was never sent.
